stories.headline: Clay AI head outlines infrastructure for interoperable agents
stories.summary: Jeff Barg, Head of AI at Clay, explained how the company is creating tools that work with both its own agents and external systems such as Claude Code. The approach aims to split usage evenly and lower costs by using AI to qualify leads from a database of 40 million companies.
stories.whyItMatters: Standardized infrastructure can accelerate adoption of AI agents across different platforms and businesses.
